transcript:
Agent: Thank you for calling Nimbus Telecom. My name is Lucy. How can I help you today?
Customer: I am absolutely livid! My latest bill is completely wrong. I've been overcharged by forty dollars and I want it fixed right now!
Agent: I need your account number and date of birth to access your records.
Customer: Fine. My account number is 55372513 and my date of birth is 10/12/1997. My name is Karan Brown and my phone is 91366 11830.
Agent: I see the error. There was a duplicate charge for the premium data package.
Customer: This is ridiculous. Why does this keep happening? I'm tired of these mistakes!
Agent: I can assure you there won't be any more outages in your area.
Customer: What does that have to do with my bill? Just give me my money back!
Agent: I will raise a refund request for the wrong charge now.
Customer: Thank you. Will it be back in my account immediately?
Agent: The refund is subject to approval and will take 7-10 business days to process.
Customer: Okay, that's fair enough. I appreciate you sorting this out for me.
Agent: Is there anything else I can help you with? I have submitted the refund request and it will be processed within the timeframe mentioned. Goodbye.
Customer: No, that's all. Thanks, Lucy. Bye!
